name: Database Query Regression on Order History
description: Simulates a release (v4.2.1, commit abc123) that modified the order retrieval query, introducing an unindexed sort and table scan, causing high database latency and API slowdowns.

default_parameters.regressed_query: SELECT orders.*, order_items.* FROM orders LEFT JOIN order_items ON orders.id = order_items.order_id ORDER BY orders.created_at DESC
